summary: Temporary danger area for drone flights within 1.6 nautical miles of Great Yorkshire Showground, Harrogate, up to 400 feet, 0800 to 2300.
text:
TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD390D INSTALLED WI 1.6NM RADIUS OF
535858N 0013033W (GREAT YORKSHIRE SHOWGROUND, HARROGATE). BEYOND
VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT (BVLOS) UAS OPS CONTAINED WHOLLY WI THE TDA.
MAX HGT 400FT AGL. EMERG SERVICES ACFT MAY ENTER THE AIRSPACE IN
ACCORDANCE WITH LOCAL DECONFLICTION AGREEMENTS. OPEN AND SPECIFIC
CAT VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT VLOS UAS OPS ARE PERMITTED WI THE TDA
WITHOUT PRIOR APPROVAL OR DECONFLICTION. OTHER NON-STANDARD
FLIGHT, FLIGHT RESTRICTION ZONE OR CONTROLLED AIRSPACE APPROVALS
MUST BE OBTAINED. OPERATORS ARE REMINDED OF THEIR RESPONSIBILITY
UNDER CAP722 5.2.2.3 REGARDING OPR IN CLOSE PROXIMITY TO AN EMERG
RESPONSE EFFORT. FOR INFO AROPS(AT)CAA.CO.UK. AR-2026-5768/01.
